rule.name: Dynamic Daily ROI
rule.cell: checkpoint × best-price sportsbook × HR Form band
rule.all_time_gate: At least 40 settled bets, 4 wins, 5 slates, and positive net units.
rule.trailing_30d_gate: At least 5 settled bets and positive net units.
rule.trailing_14d_gate: At least 20 settled bets and ROI ≥ 10%.
rule.ranking: Among qualifying cells represented on the current slate, rank by settled-bet-weighted ROI across all history, trailing 30 days, and trailing 14 days; keep the top 3 per checkpoint.
rule.player_selection: Within those cells, take the top 2 players per checkpoint by HR Form score, then archived best price. First qualifying checkpoint per player wins.
rule.price_freeze: Freeze the exact checkpoint sportsbook and price; never substitute a later quote.
rule.staking: One flat unit per settled HR prop. No plate appearance is a void.

research.note: Hyperparameters were selected on the development period only. September 12–25 was held out until after ranking.
